latin: Si Syriani theologiam sequamur, rationabile est ecclesiasticae hierarchiae sacerdotes in coelesti hierarchia anagogicis uirtutibus proportionari.
translation: If we follow the theology of Syrianus, it is reasonable that the priests of the ecclesiastical hierarchy be proportioned, by anagogic virtues, to ranks in the celestial hierarchy.
